description.value: McDonald's on Ladner Trunk Road is a fast food restaurant in Tsawwassen offering burgers, breakfast, McCafé coffee, and snacks with a drive-through and outdoor patio seating. OSM records it as open 24/7, making it a reliable any-hour stop for touring cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen area. An on-site PlayPlace adds to its appeal as a rest and refuel point for families on tour.
